title: The EKO System Podcast |  Ep 4 LIVE
description:
Tonight Craig Moore II gets on the table. The grants that didn't come through. The equipment downgrade. The self-doubt that followed. And the question every leader eventually has to answer: what does it cost you to build without laying your own foundation first?
